name: HelixMod
summary: The original DirectX 9 stereoscopic fix framework, predating 3DMigoto and Geo-11. Injects Dual-View Rendering into DX9 games via a d3d9.dll proxy. Hundreds of fixes were written for HelixMod during the 3D Vision era. For DX9 games, HelixMod fixes remain the primary approach. One DX11 fix exists: BioShock Infinite.
compatibility_notes: DirectX 9 only (except BioShock Infinite, which uses a special DX11 HelixMod build). Still functional on modern hardware. Requires Nvidia 3D Vision driver (425.31) for nvidia_dx9 output mode, or can output SBS/TAB for modern use without the legacy driver.
